candidateDecisions.label: Molecular biology, health and biological data
Neurobiology and evolutionary psychobiology
candidateDecisions.reason: Neurobiology and evolutionary psychobiology have a real elective basis. UCR covers comparative neurobiology, perception and brain functions, but the specialist evolutionary behaviour sequence is thinner. The three retained options cover more of the Biology target.

stoppingDecision.assessment: The broad option retains a cells-to-ecosystems spine. The two other options build sustained emphases around molecular and health science with quantitative methods, and around ecology and environmental change. Comparative neurobiology contributes to the broad and molecular options. A separate behaviour option would cover less of the Biology target.

analysis: The broad option progresses from diversity, cells and programming into evolutionary genetics, ecosystems, physiology and molecular lab work, then marine ecology, infection, disease and agricultural impacts. It covers plant diversity and farming but lacks the depth of UvA plant development, reproduction and stress physiology. The molecular and health option advances through molecular cells, biomolecules, lab work and physiology to genetics, infection, pharmacology and disease. Its computational strand moves from Python, statistics and data work into numerical methods, predictive validation and neural networks. Epidemiology adds actual study-design and confounding work. Image processing gives technical support, and the description-only Perception & Action adds evidence-based study of sensory and motor function. The ecology option develops biodiversity, phylogeny, population and ecosystem modelling, then marine ecology, farming, soils and nutrient cycling. Pollution remediation includes phytoremediation and mycoremediation alongside resource recovery. The description-only Earth System Science Tools supports model and proxy interpretation; Natural Hazards gives environmental context. No dedicated botany, broad zoology or required research project is claimed. Kept the elective space unfilled. Removed unsupported or weak pairings and kept general statistics, academic skills, bioinformatics and project differences legible as unmatched components. The neurobiology and evolutionary psychobiology candidate has real support, but its specialist behavioural evolution progression is thinner and the selected molecular and broad options already use comparative neurobiology.
